description.text: Mechanics is a fundamental discipline that studies the laws of mechanical motion of matter. It aims to explore the relationship between force, motion and deformation, and solve mechanical problems in engineering and science through mathematical modeling and experimental analysis. As a bridge between physics and engineering, mechanics encompasses both theoretical research (such as classical mechanics and quantum mechanics) and engineering applications (such as structural mechanics and fluid mechanics), and it serves as the core foundation in fields like aerospace, machinery, civil engineering, and materials science.

duration.text: The Mechanics at Xi'an Jiaotong University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

Original and notarized copy of the highest academic degree certificate (required for fresh graduates)The official pre-graduation certificate issued by the school.6. Original and notarized transcripts of academic records from the undergraduate stage onwardsScanned copies of transcripts should include those for undergraduate, master's (if any), and doctoral (if any) degreesThere is the learning stage, up to the grades of the most recent semester. The transcript should be byIssued by the Academic Affairs Office, Graduate School or relevant student management department of the school attendedAnd affix the seal.7. Recommendation letterTwo letters, issued by a professor or associate professor. If the applicant has already contacted our school's supervisorThe applicant is requested to contact the supervisor to issue the "Xi 'an Jiaotong UniversityOne of the two recommendation letters is the "Recommendation Letter from the Supervisor of the International Student". 8. Study or research plan in ChinaApplicants are required to submit a study or research plan in China written in either Chinese or EnglishSwipe. A master's degree holder should write no less than 800 words, and a doctoral degree holder no less than 1,500 words. 9. Research achievementsPublished papers, award certificates, invention patents, etc. prove one's academic achievementsInformation on achievements and research capabilities. 10. Proof of language proficiency 11. Copy of a valid ordinary passportThe validity period of the passport should be later than September 2025 If it does not meet the requirements, please contact us promptlyA new passport will be issued when necessary

requirements.text: 1. Non-chinese citizens in good health;2. Degree and age requirementsApplicants to study for a master's degree in China must have a bachelor's degree and be under the age of 1835 years old;Those who come to China to pursue a doctoral degree must have a master's degree and be no older than the required ageForty years old.3. Not other scholarship recipients
